title: Free Open source Project Management Software
author: beta_1457
selftext:
I've been using ClickUp and Obsidian for my project management software.

Obsidian is free, but it's a bit cumbersome to use and get used to.

I actually really like ClickUp, but I hit my limit and now they want $8 a month from me.

So instead... I created my own in an evening with Claude with the features I use and liked from ClickUp.

It's completely free, feel free to use or edit/share it. No attribution needed.

You host it locally and it can integrate with your AI coding agent to keep your task tracking, and architecture documentation up to date.

It's not meant or secure to use outside your local network. So remote use is meant to use whatever VPN you use to access your local network.

  
Pretty much anyone could vibe code this in a few hours, it's not really anything special. But it's here if you want it and don't want to make it yourself. Or if you want to build off it.

  
[https://github.com/Beta1457/project\_manager](https://github.com/Beta1457/project_manager)
